componentDescription:
A component that takes user input.
It renders the `baseTextField` slot.

autoComplete.description: The autocomplete attribute of the input element.

autoFocus.description: If true, the input element is focused during the first mount.

className.description: Override or extend the styles applied to the component.

color.description: The color of the text field.

disabled.description: If true, the text field is disabled.

error.description: If true, the text field is displayed in an error state.

fullWidth.description: If true, the text field takes up the full width of its container.

helperText.description: The helper text displayed below the input.

id.description: The id of the input element.

inputRef.description: A ref to the input element.

label.description: The label of the text field.

multiline.description: If true, a textarea element is rendered instead of an input.

placeholder.description: The short hint displayed in the input before the user enters a value.

render.description: A function to customize rendering of the component.

role.description: The ARIA role of the root element.

size.description: The size of the text field.

slotProps.description: The props used for each slot inside.

type.description: The type of the input element.

value.description: The value of the input element.
